name: The Blob That Doubles
error: This encounter cannot be implemented under the supplied engine laws.
conflicts: L3 pushes move an existing block. No rule creates duplicate blocks or replaces sliding with duplication.
L5 collapses terrain only when the player leaves it. It provides no way to burn away a block copy.
required_engine_changes: Define a blob entity whose push creates two perpendicular copies, including what happens to the original and how occupied or void destinations behave.
Define how collapse ledges remove blob copies.
